purpose: Pre-register independent measurement and negative-control sites for the SARGuardian NISAR displacement engine. This registry is a protocol/lead inventory, not evidence that SARGuardian has detected or reproduced any result.

current_engine_claim_boundary.permitted_claim: Exploratory NISAR GOFF displacement measurements and spatial motion summaries, subject to source identity, geometry, valid-pixel and reference-region checks.
prohibited_claims: Operational hazard detection or early warning
Paper reproduction before exact source-byte and method parity are verified
Training and scoring on the same event without a frozen blind holdout
Treating GUNW line-of-sight interferometry as equivalent to GOFF horizontal offset tracking
Claiming a positive detector from a single-event visual match

preregister_before_scoring: Exact product IDs, data maturity, polarization, track and flight direction
Acquisition times and pair interval; do not equate interval-average rate with instantaneous velocity
Source-byte SHA-256, request/config SHA-256, software revision and environment
Pixel quality gates, coherence policy, null/control procedure, and valid-pixel support
Independent reference product and its temporal/spatial support
Site role (positive movement, event/non-event hazard discrimination, or cross-product control)
minimum_reporting: Per-pair valid AOI pixels and valid fraction
East/north displacement, horizontal magnitude and interval-average rate
Spatial uncertainty and sensitivity to masks, geometry height, coherence neighbours and reference policy
Difference against independently sourced reference measurements
Failure reasons and missing data preserved, never silently dropped
evaluation_protocol.pass_policy: No numeric universal threshold is predeclared here. Freeze site-specific tolerances and model thresholds using the reference methods and training sites before opening the final holdout.
evaluation_protocol.split_policy: Bhote Koshi is the author-method reproduction target and must not also serve as an independent blind holdout after tuning. The glacier sites are measurement positives; Budhi Gandaki is a distinct GUNW cross-product no-precursor case until a compatible GUNW adapter and matched protocol exist.

sites.display_name: Bhote Koshi ice-rock avalanche source, Nepal

reference.title: NISAR offsets measure pre-failure motion but do not single out the Bhote Koshi avalanche source

published_reference.conclusion: Motion was measurable but did not clear the reported 95th percentile; no acceleration was resolved and the source was not distinctive against the calibrated population.

aois.geometry_status: PUBLISHED_RECTANGLE_TRANSCRIBED; raw per-pixel geometry and vertical datum require separate validation

sites.expected_engine_test: Recover comparable pre-event displacement magnitude/direction under a frozen mask/reference protocol, while preserving the non-distinctive hazard-discrimination conclusion.
caveats: The historical first-pair X05026 version is not a substitute for author-selected P05023.
The co-event pair decorrelates and must remain a potential unmeasurable interval, not a fabricated displacement.
A measured pre-event movement is not evidence that this event was predictable.

sites.expected_engine_test: Recover coherent glacier-flow spatial pattern and compare compatible velocity summaries to ITS_LIVE after reconciling temporal baseline, projection, masks and units.
caveats: Published NISAR is a single pair and ITS_LIVE is a multi-year/multi-sensor reference; ranges are not pointwise interchangeable without harmonization.
Exact acquisition IDs, scene footprints, AOI polygon and reference raster must be pinned before scoring.

sites.expected_engine_test: Recover coherent glacier-flow spatial pattern and compare compatible velocity summaries to ITS_LIVE after reconciling temporal baseline, projection, masks and units.
caveats: Published NISAR is a single pair and ITS_LIVE is a multi-year/multi-sensor reference.
Exact acquisition IDs, AOI polygon and reference raster must be pinned before scoring.

sites.expected_engine_test: Test whether the same frozen GOFF processing recovers the main flow structure while preserving the documented high-speed mismatch/speckle sensitivity.
caveats: Do not tune a correction solely to force agreement with ITS_LIVE.
The reported 20% difference is a comparator challenge, not an acceptable tolerance selected by SARGuardian.

sites.expected_engine_test: Recover the main high-speed flow structure and characterize sensitivity to speckle treatment without tuning on this site as the only fast-glacier sample.
caveats: The reported convergence depended on speckle correction; preserve pre-correction and post-correction results separately.

sites.display_name: Budhi Gandaki / Ungilung Khola rock-ice avalanche and flood, Nepal

reference.title: A steadily flowing glacier and no detectable precursor before the 11 October 2026 Budhi Gandaki rock–ice avalanche and flood, Nepal

published_reference.product_type: NISAR L-band GUNW interferograms / line-of-sight interferometry
published_reference.reported_finding: No unusual LOS motion was reported on the hanging glacier in the pair ending 9.5 hours before collapse.

sites.expected_engine_test: After a versioned GUNW adapter exists, check that the frozen procedure does not invent a precursor where independent LOS observations report none.
caveats: Do not score this as a GOFF false negative/true negative until the same product type and a compatible measurement protocol are available.
Event source geometry and exact input products must be pinned independently.
